result.note: Tests what the US PERM programme is, who announced the October 2026 suspension and how far it reaches, skipping the firm-by-firm list.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, the United States suspended several IT firms, including Infosys, Wipro and TCS, from the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM). Consider the following statements:
items: PERM is the route employers use to sponsor H-1B visa holders for green cards.
The suspension covers only new applications, and pending applications involving the firms will continue to be processed.
The move was announced alongside the US Vice-President, who heads the US Anti-Fraud Task Force.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the Labor Department said it would neither accept new applications nor process pending ones involving the firms. Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling announced the suspension alongside Vice-President JD Vance, and it also covered Microsoft, Adobe, Cognizant and Capgemini.
questions.source: He said his department would not accept new applications or process pending ones involving the firms.
